task_language: stack the right bowl on the left bowl and place them in the tray

subtasks.name: pick(right_bowl)
subtasks.outcome: never attempted: pi0 picked the left bowl (the base) instead

subtasks.name: place(stacked_bowls, tray, in)
subtasks.outcome: partial: left (base) bowl alone placed in the tray

behaviour_summary: pi0 grasped the robot's-left bowl (image right, the stacking base), carried it straight into the tray, then hovered above the tray until timeout; the right bowl never moved.

failures.mode_definition: In a multi-step instruction, pi0 skips an intermediate subtask (e.g. stacking one object on another) and carries a single object straight to the final destination, then never completes the remaining steps.
hl_remedy: HALT once a single bowl is carried toward the tray before the stack VERIFY passes
if the base (left) bowl already sits in the tray: REPROMPT 'pick up the right bowl and place it on the left bowl'
otherwise RETREAT up 10 cm and REPROMPT 'pick up the right bowl and place it on the left bowl'
VERIFY right bowl rests in left bowl
if the stack is not yet in the tray: REPROMPT 'pick up the left bowl and place it in the tray'
WATCH 5 s; retry once, then ESCALATE
failures.prevention: Coordinator issues the stack and the place as two separate prompts and advances only after a VERIFY that the top bowl rests inside the base bowl.
failures.observation: Step 40 gripper above the image-right bowl (= robot's left, the intended base); 60-80 grasped and lifted; 100-120 carried left; 140 lowered into the tray; 160-409 bowl in tray with gripper hovering over it. Image-left (right) bowl never touched.

notes: Wrong first bowl (base instead of top) plus skipped stack, recorded as one HL failure. Same image-right bowl is taken as in task63_fail_init1, although the instruction is mirrored: pi0's bowl choice appears insensitive to left/right in the language. The base bowl ending in the tray makes an in-place stack a cheap recovery.
